DOOR RAIN GUTTER CHECK

Operation

  • that there is no dirt, leaves, etc.
  • that the fitting is correct in the corner (the seal should not cover the special air inlet port)

Continue to Step 2

  • condition of seal

Continue to Step 3

All OK

door incorrectly fitted
